basis: NIST SP 800-63B-4 (2025): passwords used as the only login factor
lengthUnit: Unicode code points after NFC normalization

estimator.name: zxcvbn
estimator.python: zxcvbn 4.5.0, called with max_length equal to maxLength

checks.rule: Fails when the normalized password has fewer than minLength characters.
Fails when the normalized password has more than maxLength characters.

Lowercase the password. Fails when it contains a blocked word, the username, or the email name (the part before the last @). The username and email name count only when they have at least minPersonalLength characters after trimming.
Ask the estimator for all its matches (omnimatch). Fails when one match is from its "passwords" list and covers the whole password, including other capital letters, l33t, and reversed forms.
Run the estimator with the blocked words, username, and email name as user inputs. Map its score to the highest level whose minScore it reaches. Fails when that level is below requiredLevel.
checks.message: Too easy to guess. Add more words.

result: Run the checks in order and stop at the first failure. A failed check gives the level "weak" and its id as the reason. If all checks pass, the password is accepted with the estimated level and no reason.
